posts.author: JohnFP
posts.content_md:
How many things have you bought to improve holography only to be put on the back shelf.

My collection is;

Chains and a hook to make the hanging table

Objects to make holos of

Compressor hoses and fitting to use to blow water off DCG emulsion

3 different sizes wire wound rods (tried one)

Chemicals for trial processing

Just not enough time in a week.

posts.author: edelbrp
posts.content_md:
A combo film drier and water distiller:

![Image](http://i1.ebayimg.com/01/i/02/ae/9e/36_2.JPG)

It's slow to distill, but it dries plates in about 10-15 min if you have a way to prop them up over the exhast vent on top which puts out a nice flow of warm air.

It also distills alcohol... so I've heard... ;')

The other item I have which is real handy is a green laser pointer. I use it as an instant safe light when I need extra light, or when I'm walking around the dark garage.

-Phil
